title: Are We There Yet? Revealing the Risks of Utilizing Large Language Models in Scholarly Peer Review

bias_targets.methodology: Grouping 1,000 papers into categories based on total token count and calculating the proportion of positive ratings assigned by the LLM review system to evaluate if longer papers are systematically favored.

Replacing author names and affiliations in the review prompt with those of top-tier universities, prominent AI companies, or renowned researchers (e.g., Turing Award laureates) and measuring the subsequent change in the positive rating ratio.
